critical_rules.pre_check_mandatory: Before any patch, read the file and note its version. This is your pre-check.

pre_check_flow.description: NEVER assume local state. ALWAYS fetch current version before modifying.
steps: 3. Send link to Gardener, wait for content
pre_check_flow.example: If you need to update boot_online/index.json, first request it via API. Do NOT assume you know its contents.

critical_rules.one_command_only: ALWAYS provide exactly ONE complete PowerShell command. Use backticks (`) or semicolons (;) for multi-line.
critical_rules.api_first: Before modifying, request current content via GitHub API (bypass CDN). Raw URL has 5-10 min delay.
critical_rules.laconic_communication: Responses must be concise. Avoid showing unnecessary code blocks. Only output what Gardener needs to see or execute.
critical_rules.always_fetch_before_update: Before any file modification, always request the current version via API. Never assume local state.
critical_rules.git_commit_in_script: Always include 'git add', 'git commit', and 'git push' inside the PowerShell script. Gardener only copies, pastes, and presses Enter.
critical_rules.copyable_links: When providing URLs, wrap them in a code block with 'text' (```text ... ```). This ensures the 'Copy' button appears in the interface.
critical_rules.patch_large_files_by_block: For large files (.py, .html, .js), do NOT patch with regex replace on entire file  it causes syntax errors from partial matches. Instead: 1) Identify the exact function/block to replace. 2) Use a precise multi-line regex anchored to function definition. 3) Replace ONLY that block with corrected version. 4) If unsure, replace entire file with full corrected content.

powershell_examples.description: Concrete, copy-paste ready examples for common tasks.

update_json_file.description: Replace an entire JSON file with new content.

delete_file.description: Delete a file and push the change.
delete_file.template: Remove-Item 'path/to/file.json'; git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: delete file'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push
delete_file.example: Remove-Item 'honeycombs/inbox/index.json'; git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: remove inbox'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push

move_file.template: Move-Item 'old/path' 'new/path'; git add -A; git commit -m 'refactor: move file'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push
move_file.example: Move-Item 'honeycombs/tasks/old.json' 'honeycombs/tasks/archive/old.json'; git add -A; git commit -m 'refactor: archive task'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push

create_folder_and_file.description: Create a new folder and file.
create_folder_and_file.template: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'honeycombs/new_honeycomb' -Force; @'{ ... }'@ | Out-File -FilePath 'honeycombs/new_honeycomb/index.json' -Encoding utf8; git add .; git commit -m 'feat: create new honeycomb'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push

git_cycle.one_liner: git pull --rebase origin main; git add .; git commit -m "msg"; git push

mandatory_steps: 1. Request current file content via API (pre_check)
2. Check dependencies (does any honeycomb reference this file?)
4. Use PowerShell: Remove-Item 'path'; git add -A; git commit -m 'deleted {file}'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push
file_deletion_rules.warning: NEVER delete without Gardener confirmation. NEVER delete registry or core_map.

json_update_template.description: Standard PowerShell template for updating honeycomb JSON files
json_update_template.template: $path = 'honeycombs/{module}/{file}.json'; git pull; $json = Get-Content $path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; # MODIFY JSON HERE # ; New-Item -Force -ItemType File -Path $path | Out-Null; $json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | ForEach-Object { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $path).Path, $_, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) }; git add $path; git commit -m '{module} {version}: {description}'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push

roadmaps.role: Strategic directions and large initiatives spanning multiple months.

archive.role: Completed tasks and roadmaps. Historical record.
